recent_articles.title: Rupee hits all-time low of 95.74 vs USD as outflows, oil risks weigh on outlook - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **rupee** weakened against the US dollar, reaching its new all-time low of 95.7450 per dollar.  Rising energy prices due to the U.S.-Iran war have contributed to India's macroeconomic challenges, prompting economists to revise growth forecasts and inflation projections. **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** has urged measures to conserve foreign exchange reserves, while the central government implemented tariffs on precious metal imports to stabilize the rupee. The **Reserve Bank of India (RBI)** Governor Sanjay Malhotra stated that India’s monetary policy can address temporary supply shocks but may intervene if inflationary pressures persist.

recent_articles.title: In a major reshuffle, 72 IAS officers transferred by Gujarat government - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Gujarat** government transferred 72 Indian Administrative Service (IAS) officers on Wednesday, May 13, 2026.  **D.N. Modi**, the Municipal Commissioner of Jamnagar, was appointed Development Commissioner in Gandhinagar, while **Anand Patel**, Collector of Kutch-Bhuj, became Commissioner of Schools and also took charge as Director of the Gujarat Council of Education Research and Training (GCERT). Other notable transfers included **Sujeet Kumar** to Special Commissioner of State Tax, Ahmedabad.

recent_articles.title: Manappuram Finance, IIFL Finance, other stocks rally up to 11% as gold prices soar after import duty hike - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged citizens to reduce non-essential gold purchases, citing the need to stabilize the rupee and reduce imports. **India**'s government implemented a hike in import duties on gold to address these concerns. This move is expected to decrease precious metal imports, support the rupee, and narrow the trade deficit.  The rise in gold prices has positively impacted gold financing firms like **Muthoot Finance**, **Manappuram Finance**, and **IIFL Finance** as their loans are secured by gold.

recent_articles.title: Hindustan Zinc shares surge 5% as silver prices near Rs 3 lakh/kg after import duty hike; Vedanta shares jump 4% - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** urged citizens to reduce purchases of non-essential gold and silver over the next year to alleviate pressure on foreign exchange reserves and imports. This policy measure led to a surge in import duty on silver, resulting in a 6% jump in MCX silver futures prices and a 6% rise in gold futures prices. **Hindustan Zinc**, India's largest silver producer, saw its share price climb over 5%, while **Vedanta** shares also rose significantly.  The government's push for infrastructure development is expected to boost steel demand, benefiting companies like **Hindustan Zinc**.

recent_articles.title: PM austerity appeal: State leaders take steps to limit their fuel use - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Home Minister Amit Shah**, and several other state chief ministers have implemented measures to reduce fuel consumption in response to the West Asia crisis.  These include reducing convoy sizes, promoting electric vehicles, and encouraging public transport use. **Yogi Adityanath**, **Rekha Gupta**, **Mohan Yadav**, and others have also taken steps to promote sustainability within their respective states.  **Devendra Fadnavis**, **Harsh Sanghavi**, and **Acharya Devvrat** have implemented similar measures in Maharashtra, Gujarat, and Bihar respectively.

recent_articles.title: Kalyan Jewellers, Titan, other jewellery stocks crash up to 6% as Centre hikes gold customs duty to 15% - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Indian government** has significantly increased customs duty on gold and silver imports, raising the effective import tax to 15% from 6%.  This move is expected to dampen demand in the jewelry sector, potentially leading to higher domestic prices and reduced consumer spending.  While organized players may fare better than smaller unorganized jewellers due to their stronger brands and inventory management, the increase could still negatively impact sales. The decision comes after Prime Minister Modi urged citizens to reduce gold purchases and curb imports, which have already fallen significantly in recent weeks.

recent_articles.title: Opposition parties are spreading panic over PM’s voluntary, precautionary appeal: BJP - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: The **Bharatiya Janata Party (BJP)** criticized opposition parties, accusing them of spreading misinformation about Prime Minister **Narendra Modi**’s call for voluntary gold purchases and foreign travel restrictions.  **BJP spokesperson Gaurav Bhatia** stated that the government has taken measures to protect India's economy and there is no shortage of essential commodities.

recent_articles.title: ST delegation meets CM - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Siddaramaiah**, the Chief Minister of Karnataka, has promised to convene an all-party meeting to discuss the inclusion of a 56% reservation matrix in the Ninth Schedule of the Constitution.  He also assured **V.S. Ugrappa**, former MP and leader of the Samana Manaskara Vedike, that he will take an all-party delegation to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi** to advocate for this legislation. The state government has been working to overturn a legal stay on the 56% reservation, with legal experts being consulted and a special leave petition potentially filed in the Supreme Court.

recent_articles.title: Trump downplays US-Iran differences as he heads to Beijing to meet with Xi | Xi Jinping News | Al Jazeera
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Donald Trump** departed the White House for Beijing, where he will meet with **Xi Jinping**.  The upcoming meetings will focus on trade and are expected to be the first face-to-face exchanges since October 2025. While US officials have emphasized the importance of trade, **Trump** has given conflicting messages about the prominence of the US-Israel war on Iran in the discussions.  Despite **Beijing's** opposition to the war, it is expected that both sides will seek to avoid a return to the tariff war and address concerns over arms sales to Taiwan.

recent_articles.title: India’s Hindu extremist group RSS lobbies foreign groups to counter minority rights criticism - World - DAWN.COM
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Rashtriya Swayamsevak Sangh (RSS)**, a Hindu nationalist group linked to **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, has organized foreign visits to the US, Germany, and Britain to counter accusations of being a paramilitary organization involved in attacks on minority communities. The **US Commission on International Religious Freedom** previously reported that the RSS has been involved in acts of violence against minorities for decades.  The group claims it is a "Hindu-centric civilisational, cultural movement" with goals of uniting Hindus and protecting their religion.  **Dattatreya Hosabale**, the RSS general secretary, met with policymakers and business leaders during his visits to dispel misconceptions about the organization.

recent_articles.title: Gold, housing plays take a hit as PM Modi's austerity pitch rattles consumer-facing stocks - The Economic Times
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Prime Minister Narendra Modi's** recent advice to work from home to reduce fuel consumption sparked a market reaction, impacting sectors like jewellery and real estate. **Titan Company Limited**, **Kalyan Jewellers India Limited**, and **Senco Gold Limited** saw significant declines in their share prices during intraday trading.  Analysts suggest the selloff is driven by sentiment rather than structural demand concerns, as gold remains expensive and crude oil prices remain high.

recent_articles.title: LPG price surge pushes auto, taxi operators to seek subsidy for shift to CNG, EV - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **The Federation of Private Transport Associations** has urged the **State** and **Union governments** to provide financial assistance for auto and taxi operators to transition to CNG and electric vehicles. The federation cites rising LPG prices and supply concerns as reasons for their request, noting that drivers are willing to switch but face high conversion costs without government support.  The association has formally submitted representations to both the State Transport Department and the Union government seeking subsidies to ease the process.

recent_articles.title: NSUI protests after NTA cancels NEET-UG 2026 over paper leak - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: A massive protest organized by the **National Students' Union of India (NSUI)** erupted outside the **Shastri Bhawan** on Tuesday, May 12, 2026, demanding justice for students alleging a paper leak in the NEET-UG exam.  The protest saw members of the **Congress party's student wing** participate, holding signs and slogans criticizing the government's handling of the situation. The **National Testing Agency (NTA)** canceled the examination following investigations by the **Rajasthan Special Operations Group (SOG) and the CBI**.  The NSUI accused the central government of failing to protect students and demanded the resignation of **Union Education Minister Dharmendra Pradhan** and a ban on the **NTA**.

recent_articles.title: Assam swearing-in LIVE: Himanta Biswa Sarma takes oath as Assam CM; Four MLAs sworn in as Ministers - The Hindu
recent_articles.rephrased_article: **Himanta Biswa Sarma** was sworn in as the Chief Minister of Assam for a second consecutive term on Tuesday, May 2, 2026. **Governor Lakshman Prasad Acharya** administered the oath of office at a ceremony held at the Veterinary Ground in Guwahati.  Joining **Sarma** were four other MLAs who took oaths as Ministers: **Rameswar Teli**, **Ajanta Neog**, **Atul Bora**, and **Charan Boro**. The event was attended by prominent figures including **Prime Minister Narendra Modi**, **Union Ministers Amit Shah, Rajnath Singh, Nitin Gadkari, Sarbananda Sonowal, Pabitra Margherita**, and **BJP president Nitin Nabin**. This marks the formation of a third successive NDA government in the state.
